class.name: ResonanceServer
class.brief_description: Singleton owning Steam Audio context, scene, and simulation. Driven by ResonanceRuntime.
class.description: Low-level Steam Audio engine. Prefer [ResonanceRuntime] and [ResonancePlayer] for gameplay. Use [method Engine.get_singleton] / scripting for advanced control (listener, geometry, probes, bake, instrumentation). For play-mode static rebuild, prefer [url=#ResonanceRuntimeExporter]ResonanceRuntimeExporter[/url]. [member debug_occlusion] / [member debug_reflections] gate the per-player HUD; F3 toggles them when [member ResonanceRuntime.enable_debug] is true.

signal.name: bake_progress
signal.description: Emitted during bake with progress in [code]0..1[/code] (or status-dependent range). Prefer polling [method get_bake_progress] from GDScript threads without signals.

method.name: runtime_config_property_requires_engine_reinit
method.description: True when changing this [url=#ResonanceRuntimeConfig]ResonanceRuntimeConfig[/url] property needs [method reinit_audio_engine].

method.name: runtime_config_property_is_live_patchable
method.description: True when the property can be applied via [method patch_live_runtime_config] without full reinit.

method.name: runtime_config_property_requires_routing_refresh
method.description: True when the property only needs Godot bus routing refresh (not engine reinit).

method.name: init_audio_engine
method.description: Creates Steam Audio context, scene, simulator, and HRTF from [param config] ([method ResonanceRuntime.get_config_dict]).

method.name: reinit_audio_engine
method.description: Tears down and recreates the engine for config fields that cannot live-patch. Follow with [method ResonanceRuntime.reload_after_reinit].

method.name: patch_live_runtime_config
method.description: Applies live-patchable settings without full teardown (intervals, pathing toggles, perspective, etc.).

method.name: shutdown
method.description: Ordered teardown (worker join, drain audio-thread IPL clients, release simulator/scene/context). Idempotent. Called by [ResonanceRuntime] and GDExtension exit.

method.name: get_version
method.description: Nexus Resonance version string.

method.name: is_initialized
method.description: True when the Steam Audio engine is initialized.

method.name: is_simulating
method.description: True when acoustic simulation can run (static triangles > 0, or Custom scene with a valid [World3D]).

method.name: is_spatial_audio_output_ready
method.description: True when the spatial output gate is open (warmup done and scene committed). Until then players may mute spatial DSP.

method.name: arm_spatial_audio_output_gate
method.description: Arms the spatial mute gate (cold start / full reload). Incremental geometry adds into a non-empty scene do not re-arm.

method.name: reset_spatial_audio_warmup_passes
method.description: Resets remaining warmup passes before spatial output opens.

method.name: get_sample_rate
method.description: Current sample rate from AudioServer / engine init.

method.name: get_audio_frame_size
method.description: Steam Audio processing block size in samples.

method.name: get_audio_frame_size_was_auto
method.description: True when frame size was chosen automatically from Project Settings latency.

method.name: get_direct_speaker_channels
method.description: Active non-HRTF direct speaker channel count.

method.name: consume_pending_reinit_frame_size
method.description: Returns and clears a pending post-reinit frame size hint for audio clients. Scripts rarely call this.

method.name: get_ambisonic_order
method.description: Active ambisonics order (1-3) for simulation and reverb decode.

method.name: get_default_reflections_mode
method.description: Default reflections mode for players using Use Global: [code]0[/code] Baked, [code]1[/code] Realtime.

method.name: get_reflection_type
method.description: Active reflection algorithm (Convolution / Parametric / Hybrid / TAN).

method.name: get_realtime_rays
method.description: Active realtime reflection ray count ([code]0[/code] = off).

method.name: update_listener
method.description: Updates listener pose. Called by [ResonanceListener] or [ResonanceRuntime] fallback.

method.name: set_listener_valid
method.description: When false, RunPathing is skipped (saves CPU / avoids bad listener poses).

method.name: notify_listener_changed
method.description: Notifies that the active listener node changed; runtime refreshes exclude lists / pose source.

method.name: notify_listener_changed_to
method.description: Same as [method notify_listener_changed] with an explicit listener node.

method.name: tick
method.description: Advances simulation each frame ([ResonanceRuntime]). Custom scene type runs Phonon on the main thread.

method.name: set_physics_world
method.description: [World3D] for Custom-scene raycasts. Runtime sets this each frame when initialized.

method.name: refresh_physics_materials
method.description: Reloads [ResonanceMaterial] presets for Custom-scene meta. Main thread only.

method.name: set_physics_ray_exclude_rids
method.description: User RID exclude list for Custom-scene rays. Merged with listener and source auto-excludes.

method.name: set_listener_physics_ray_exclude_rids
method.description: Replaces the listener-side Custom-scene exclude list. Runtime updates this each frame.

method.name: flush_pending_source_updates
method.description: Applies any batched deferred source simulation updates immediately.

method.name: create_source_handle
method.description: Allocates a simulation source. Returns handle or [code]-1[/code] on failure. Prefer [ResonancePlayer] for gameplay.

method.name: set_source_pathing_owner_path
method.description: Sets the pathing probe-volume owner path for a source handle.

method.name: destroy_source_handle
method.description: Releases a simulation source handle.

method.name: update_source
method.description: Updates source pose / radius for simulation (and optional Phonon distance model).

method.name: get_source_occlusion_data
method.description: Last published occlusion/transmission data for the source (audio-thread cache).

method.name: get_source_occlusion_linear_gain
method.description: Linear occlusion gain for the source from the last cache sync.

method.name: notify_geometry_changed
method.description: Notifies geometry triangle count change (dynamic add/remove).

method.name: refresh_all_geometry_from_scene_tree
method.description: Calls [method ResonanceGeometry.refresh_geometry] on every geometry node. Main thread; after [method load_scene_data].

method.name: load_scene_data
method.description: Loads serialized Steam Audio scene data. On success, defers [method refresh_all_geometry_from_scene_tree].

method.name: save_scene_data
method.description: Saves the current Steam Audio scene ([code]IPL_SCENETYPE_DEFAULT[/code] only).

method.name: save_scene_obj
method.description: Exports the current scene as OBJ+MTL (path without extension). Returns [enum Error].

method.name: load_static_scene_from_asset
method.description: Clears static packs and loads one asset at [param p_transform].

method.name: add_static_scene_from_asset
method.description: Adds a static pack without clearing existing ones.

method.name: add_or_replace_static_pack
method.description: Inserts or replaces a static pack keyed by [param object_id] (e.g. [ResonanceStaticScene] instance id).

method.name: remove_static_pack
method.description: Removes one static pack by [param object_id].

method.name: clear_static_scenes
method.description: Removes all loaded static packs.

method.name: replace_static_scenes_from_assets
method.description: Clears all static packs then loads each asset. No-op with warning when [code]scene_type[/code] is Custom. Prefer [url=#ResonanceRuntimeExporter]ResonanceRuntimeExporter[/url].

method.name: export_static_scene_to_geometry_asset
method.description: Merges visible static geometry under [param scene_root] into an in-memory asset. Prefer the runtime exporter for assign + reload.

method.name: export_static_scene_to_asset
method.description: Same merge as [method export_static_scene_to_geometry_asset], written to [param path]. Returns [enum Error].

method.name: export_static_scene_to_obj
method.description: Exports static geometry under [param scene_root] as OBJ+MTL. Returns [enum Error].

method.name: get_static_scene_hash
method.description: Hash of exportable static geometry under [param scene_root] (skip re-export when unchanged).

method.name: get_geometry_asset_hash
method.description: Hash of asset mesh bytes (detect static scene changes for probe rebake).

method.name: set_bake_params
method.description: Sets bake quality parameters for the next bake call.

method.name: set_bake_static_scene_asset
method.description: Sets a single static asset for the isolated bake scene.

method.name: set_bake_static_scenes_from_assets
method.description: Sets multiple static packs for the isolated bake scene.

method.name: set_bake_pipeline_pathing
method.description: Hint that pathing will follow reflections in this bake pipeline.

method.name: set_bake_pipeline_active
method.description: True while the editor bake pipeline runs (skips mid-pipeline probe reload validation).

method.name: is_bake_pipeline_active
method.description: True while [method set_bake_pipeline_active] is set.

method.name: generate_manual_grid
method.description: Generates probe positions in a volume (manual grid / centroid / etc.).

method.name: generate_probes_scene_aware
method.description: Scene-aware probe placement inside the volume.

method.name: bake_manual_grid
method.description: Bakes reflections into [param dat] at the given probe points.

method.name: bake_probes_for_volume
method.description: Full reflections bake for a probe volume (generate + bake). Prefer the editor bake runner / [url=#ResonanceRuntimeBaker]ResonanceRuntimeBaker[/url].

method.name: bake_pathing
method.description: Bakes the pathing layer into [param dat] (requires prior reflections bake).

method.name: bake_static_source
method.description: Bakes a STATICSOURCE layer at [param endpoint_position].

method.name: bake_static_listener
method.description: Bakes a STATICLISTENER layer at [param endpoint_position].

method.name: cancel_reflections_bake
method.description: Requests cancel of an in-progress reflections bake.

method.name: cancel_pathing_bake
method.description: Requests cancel of an in-progress pathing bake.

method.name: get_bake_progress
method.description: Atomic bake progress poll ([code]0..1[/code]). Safe from bake threads without Godot signals.

method.name: load_probe_batch
method.description: Loads baked probe data into the simulator. Returns batch handle or [code]-1[/code].

method.name: remove_probe_batch
method.description: Unloads a probe batch by handle.

method.name: clear_probe_batches
method.description: Unloads all probe batches. Do not call while volumes still hold handles unless intentional.

method.name: revalidate_probe_batches_with_config
method.description: Re-checks loaded batches against current runtime reflection/pathing settings.

method.name: editor_probe_data_get_num_probes
method.description: Number of probes in [param dat] (editor tooling).

method.name: editor_probe_data_remove_probe
method.description: Removes one probe from [param dat] (editor tooling).

method.name: editor_probe_data_remove_baked_layer
method.description: Removes a baked data layer from [param dat] (editor tooling).

method.name: probe_data_static_source_energy_at
method.description: Queries baked static-source energy between endpoint and listener (tooling).

method.name: probe_data_query_baked_at_point
method.description: Interpolates baked energy at [param world_position]. Variation: 0 Reverb, 1 Static Source, 2 Static Listener. Optional IR reconstruction. Main-thread tooling only.

method.name: probe_data_query_baked_at_probe
method.description: Reads baked energy for one probe index without spatial interpolation.

method.name: set_pathing_deviation_callable
method.description: Builds a pathing deviation LUT from [code]callable(angle_rad, band) -> float[/code] on the main thread. Do not call into [ResonanceServer] from the Callable while this runs.

method.name: clear_pathing_deviation_callback
method.description: Restores default UTD pathing deviation.

method.name: is_pathing_deviation_custom_enabled
method.description: True when a custom deviation Callable/LUT is active.

method.name: get_pathing_visualization_segments
method.description: Path vis segments when [member debug_pathing] is on. Not drawn by F3; for scripts.

method.name: get_ray_debug_segments
method.description: Last debug reflection ray segments (when realtime rays / debug reflections are active).

method.name: get_ray_debug_segments_at
method.description: Debug reflection rays from [param origin].

method.name: uses_custom_ray_tracer
method.description: True when [code]scene_type[/code] is Custom (Godot physics).

method.name: wants_debug_reflection_viz
method.description: True when reflection ray visualization should be sampled this frame.

method.name: is_pathing_enabled
method.description: Whether runtime pathing simulation is enabled.

method.name: set_pathing_enabled
method.description: Enables or disables runtime pathing (live when the simulator supports it).

method.name: peek_reverb_params_likely_available
method.description: Cheap check whether reflection cache likely has usable params for [param source_handle]. Does not lock simulation.

method.name: get_simulation_worker_timing
method.description: Last sim step timings (us): [code]us_run_direct[/code], [code]us_run_reflections[/code], [code]us_run_pathing[/code], [code]us_sync_fetch[/code], commit keys. Cleared by [method reset_pathing_instrumentation].

method.name: get_convolution_audio_timing
method.description: Convolution-only mix-thread timings (us): [code]us_reflection_apply_last[/code], [code]us_reverb_bus_last[/code], sanitize splits. Cleared by [method reset_reverb_bus_instrumentation].

method.name: get_simulation_tracer_profile
method.description: Setup profile: [code]scene_type[/code], [code]ipl_scene_type[/code], [code]ray_batch_size_effective[/code], batched Custom flags.

method.name: get_reverb_bus_instrumentation
method.description: Reverb bus debug counters (click guard, underrun, etc.).

method.name: reset_reverb_bus_instrumentation
method.description: Clears reverb bus instrumentation and convolution timing fields.

method.name: get_pathing_instrumentation
method.description: Pathing debug counters.

method.name: reset_pathing_instrumentation
method.description: Clears pathing instrumentation and worker timing fields.

method.name: get_active_source_count
method.description: Number of live simulation sources.

method.name: get_active_probe_batch_count
method.description: Number of loaded probe batches.

method.name: get_source_lifecycle_epoch
method.description: Increments on source-handle lifecycle recycle (reinit). Players invalidate stale handles against this.

members.member: Show the per-player 3D HUD label (with [member debug_reflections]). F3 sets this with the player overlay.
Show the per-player debug label (occlusion, transmission, signal meters).
Records path vis segments for [method get_pathing_visualization_segments]. Not drawn in the viewport; F3 does not toggle this.
Enable direct sound output. Normally true via config; useful for debug A/B.
Master wet-path gate for reflections and pathing. Direct uses [member output_direct].
Short ramp on the convolution bus when wet peak collapses in one callback. Disable for A/B wet-tail tests.
On split-reverb ring underrun, fill with silence instead of hold x cosine taper.
Third-person perspective correction for spatialized sources. Live from runtime config.
Perspective correction factor when [member perspective_correction_enabled] is true.
